description:
Chronology of a company's filing documents (metadata, newest first). Read-only.

        Parameters:
        - company_id (required): "AT:{fnr}" (bare FNR accepted). Austria only; for the German
          official register abstract use get_document with a "DE:" id instead.

        Returns the AT backend's document list plus ``country`` and the prefixed
        ``company_id``: each entry has type, Stichtag, financial_year, document_ref, format and
        whether it was parsed. Feed a document_ref to get_document_text for the extracted text.
name: list_documents
title: List filing documents of a company (AT)
